Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Can vampire A play superior Decapitate to burn vampire B if B is going
to torpor due to a Mummify (S:CE)?.

Thanks,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Damnans wrote:
>
> Can vampire A play superior Decapitate to burn vampire B if B is going
> to torpor due to a Mummify (S:CE)?.

No. Mummify ends combat before sending the vampire to torpor.
